Project review rules for PR CI:

- Review only the PR diff and directly related context. Ignore unrelated pre-existing issues.
- Fail only for real problems: correctness regressions, broken behavior, mismatched interfaces, dangerous security/privacy issues, or clearly broken build/runtime logic.
- Do not fail for minor style preferences, naming preferences, or speculative refactors.
- Repository trust model for this CI:
  - Same-repository branches are considered trusted for this workflow.
  - Fork PRs are not part of this threat model.
  - Do not fail solely because the PR can modify this workflow, the Codex prompt, or review-rules files, or because same-repo PR preparation steps run before the review.
  - You may mention such things in `warnings` if they are relevant, but they are not blocking findings for this repository policy.

- Always verify the full wallet API mapping surface, even if the PR diff only touches one side of it:
  - Keep the C++ Embind surface in `monero-wasm-src/monero-wasm-wallet/wasm_wallet_api.cpp` aligned with the TypeScript API surface in `monero-wasm-module/walletApi.ts`.
  - Also verify related worker exposure stays aligned across `monero-wasm-module/walletApi.worker.ts` and `monero-wasm-module/walletApi.workerClient.ts`.
  - Check the whole mapping for methods, enums, object fields, callback shapes, and return shapes, not just the changed lines.
  - If any current mismatch exists across those mapping layers, fail, even if only one side changed in the PR.
  - If UI code calls a wallet API method or reads a wallet API field that is missing or mismatched relative to the current TS/C++ bindings, fail.

- Flag obvious debug leftovers introduced by the PR, including `console.log`, temporary prints, or ad hoc diagnostics that should not ship.
- Flag obvious leakage of sensitive wallet data, seeds, keys, or raw secrets through logs, UI, storage, or error messages.
- Flag newly introduced blocking or obviously unsafe logic in user-facing flows when the surrounding code expects async/non-blocking behavior.
- Flag broken imports, exports, renamed symbols, or impossible control flow introduced by the PR.
